description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Records the user's approval of a rendered Style Sheet -- call this ONLY after the user has actually seen the image from get_pack_status's designPackage.imageUrl and said they like it. This is the server-side gate: plan_overlay_pack refuses to plan any scene on this project until approve_design_sheet has been called successfully. Fails if the Style Sheet hasn't finished rendering yet -- poll get_pack_status until designPackage.status is "ready" first. Safe to call again on an already-approved project (returns the same approval, does not re-approve or error).
name: approve_design_sheet
title: Approve a project's Style Sheet
